prompts.prompt_text: What are the best AEO platforms for marketing agencies?
Which tools measure how AI assistants describe a brand?
What should I use to track my brand in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini?
Which Answer Engine Optimization tools can audit and fix AI visibility?
What are the top AI visibility monitoring tools for agencies?
Which platforms offer white-label AEO reporting for agencies?
How can a brand find out which pages AI engines cite about it, and which tool does that?
What tools generate schema and content fixes for AI search visibility?
Which AEO tools certify a brand's AI visibility?
What is the best alternative to traditional SEO tools for AI search?

basis: api row per engine; search row for retrieval engines

definition.first_agreement: For one prompt asked of one engine in one mode on one night: 1.0 when every successful answer names the same tool first, 0.5 when two of three do, 0.0 otherwise; not defined with fewer than two successful answers or when none of them names a tool.
definition.set_agreement: For the same cell, the average overlap (Jaccard index) between the sets of tools each pair of successful answers names; 1.0 means identical sets and 0.0 means nothing in common.
